statement: Fix s ≥ 1, put n = ps, and choose A0/κ and P ∈ A0(κ) of exact order n as in Lemma 4.1. There are finitely generated fields F0 ⊂ F′ over κ, each of transcendence degree n, and a smooth projective geometrically integral genus-one curve E/F0 with the following properties: (i) F′ = κ(An 0 ), and F′/F0 is cyclic Galois of degree n. With ti ∈ A0(F′) the generic projection points, a generator satisfies σ(ti) = ti+1 − P (i modulo n). (4.6) 23 (ii) Under an identification EF′ ≃ A0,F′ , the descent action on points is x ↦→ σ(x) + P. The two disjoint divisors BF′ = n ∑︂ i=1 [ti], DF′ = n−1 ∑︂ j=0 [jP] (4.7) descend to finite étale effective divisors B, D of degree n on E, and D is ample. (iii) The index of E/F0 is exactly n.
